summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to ESLint plugin purpose
details: The package declares an ESLint plugin purpose but its package.json preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes the sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly downloaded runtime. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bytecode bundle with rotated string arrays and mangled identifiers (`WV8StW`, `MmgoCP`, `_0x...`), and has no relationship to ESLint rule definitions. `setup.mjs` itself is hex-identifier obfuscated (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-scope string-lookup objects). Installing the package triggers execution of the obfuscated Bun-compiled payload on the installer's machine at `npm install` time, using an alternate runtime chosen specifically to run bytecode that Node.js-based tooling cannot inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
